question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation constitute a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment can belong to a practitioner
Possessing it makes one dear to the yoginis
inference: A practitioner endowed with the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: One who attains the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
